List Conda environments managed by condathis

Source: R/list_envs.R
list_envs.Rd

Returns a data frame of the environments under the data directory of each registered backend. It leaves out environments that condathis does not manage.

Usage

list_envs(method = "auto", verbose = "silent")

Arguments

method

Character string naming the backend to query. "auto" (the default) covers every registered backend, in getOption("condathis.backend_priority") order, also a backend that reports itself unavailable. The name of a registered backend (see list_registered_backend_names()) queries only that backend. "micromamba" is built in. The name of a backend whose package condathis knows, such as "rattler" of the rattlerthis package, also queries only that backend. condathis loads that package. When it is not installed, the call aborts with class condathis_backend_not_installed. "native" is a deprecated alias for "micromamba" (warns once per session). Invalid values abort with class condathis_invalid_method.

verbose

Character string that controls the console output. One of:

  • "output": show the output of the command and the messages of condathis.

  • "silent": show nothing.

  • "cmd": show the command line.

  • "spinner": show only a spinner.

  • "full": show the command line, the output, and the backend's own log.

TRUE means "output" and FALSE means "silent". Every level except "silent" shows a spinner in interactive sessions. It also shows these messages and this warning when they occur (see condathis-conditions):

  • condathis_micromamba_downloading (a message): no usable micromamba was found, so it is downloaded. Queries, such as list_envs(), never download it.

  • condathis_env_lock_waiting and condathis_cache_lock_waiting (messages): the call waits for another R session.

  • condathis_install_micromamba_checksum_unavailable (a warning): the checksum of the downloaded micromamba could not be checked.

Invalid values abort with class condathis_invalid_verbose. The default is shown in Usage.

The command line shown, the cmd of a result and the messages of condathis show the password and the token of a URL as *****. micromamba does the same (https://user:*****@host/channel, https://host/t/*****/channel). The command still gets them.

Value

A data frame (a tibble) with one row per environment and the columns backend (chr), env_name (chr) and path (chr). The rows follow the backend order of method. When the listing fails for the backend that method names, list_envs() aborts with class condathis_list_envs_failed (also condathis_backend_error). With method = "auto", list_envs() skips a backend whose listing fails and warns with class condathis_backend_query_failed. It aborts only when every backend fails.

Details

list_envs() is a query: it never creates an environment. On a new data directory, with no environment yet, it returns a data frame with no rows. It does not start or install micromamba. When no micromamba binary is installed, the micromamba backend reads the envs directory of its data directory and the package records in conda-meta/ instead. It never installs micromamba.

See also

condathis-conditions for every condition class.

Other environments: create_env(), env_exists(), env_path(), get_env_dir(), install_packages(), list_packages(), remove_env(), validate_env()

Examples

condathis::with_sandbox_dir({
  # No environment yet: a data frame with no rows
  print(condathis::list_envs())
})
#> # A tibble: 0 × 3
#> # ℹ 3 variables: backend <chr>, env_name <chr>, path <chr>

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
condathis::with_sandbox_dir({
  # A local channel shipped with condathis, with `polyglot`: a
  # dependency-free script that runs on Linux, macOS and Windows.
  channel <- system.file(
    "extdata", "polyglot-channel",
    package = "condathis"
  )

  # Create environments
  condathis::create_env(
    "polyglot",
    env_name = "polyglot-env",
    channels = channel
  )
  condathis::create_env(env_name = "empty-env")

  # List environments
  print(condathis::list_envs()$env_name)
  #> [1] "empty-env"    "polyglot-env"
})
} # }
